card.name: Words just before a combination or pair
card.fires_on: Words right before a noun like combination, pair, or duo, where a two-part set is being named. Includes 'this' before 'combination' or 'concurrent use', and partway through paired drug names like ritonavir.

modes.label: This before combination
modes.description: The word 'this' or 'a' refers back to two drugs used together, and 'combination' or 'pair' would come next.
modes.example: as<< this>> combination can potentially cause symptomatic hypot

modes.label: Inside the second drug of a pair
modes.description: Partway through the name of a drug given with another, as in darunavir with ritonavir or amoxicillin and clavulanate.
modes.example: Darunavir 4 mL b (385 mg) with<< rit>>onavir 0.8 mL

modes.label: Good or half of a team
modes.description: Words in non-drug text that lead into a pairing or team idea.
modes.example: perfect half of<< a>> dog guide team.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words like pair, pairs, pairing, duo, and combination.
card.plain: It fires where the text is about to name two things used or working together as a pair.
